verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's marketing page mentions 'Agents monitor your product continuously, surface insights before you think to ask, and tell your team exactly what to do next' (docs-47), implying some autonomous background monitoring capability, but there is no technical documentation describing how to configure, trigger, or manage such automations, nor any independent confirmation that this feature works as an autonomous background agent. Missing for 10: setup/configuration docs for the 'Agents' feature, description of trigger conditions or scheduling, independent/hands-on verification that it runs autonomously without user prompting.
